title: Kneadable Mediterranean Pepper Stir-fry
description: A rich, flaky, cozy mediterranean dish featuring sweet peppadew peppers in a low-calorie-friendly twist, perfect for an easy dinner.
instructions: Wash and chop the Peppadew Peppers, Red Bell Pepper, and Garlic.
In a medium-sized skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add chopped peppers and garlic; sauté for about 2 minutes until fragrant.
Mix in Tomato Sauce, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine all the ingredients evenly.
Transfer the mixture into a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until the peppers are soft and the sauce is slightly thickened.
Serve hot as a side dish or with pita bread, quinoa salad, or any other Mediterranean-inspired meal.
